calls.title: GrowthBook & Van De Velde Follow Up
calls.summary: The discussion highlighted the need for a straightforward, code-linked A/B testing solution to replace Dynamic Yield, focusing on ease of use and integration into the current tech stack. The team led by Janne noted gaps in their current experiment management due to inefficient manual analysis via Excel and emphasized simplifying the experiment setup. GrowthBook was identified as a potential solution with deep BigQuery integration, enabling flexible data analysis across multiple brands. The conversation also covered the modular approach of GrowthBook's features and the importance of cost-effective pricing aligned with Van de Velde's budget constraints. A decision is expected by the end of June, with a follow-up proposal scheduled for June 8th.
calls.keywords: A/B testing, GrowthBook, BigQuery integration, feature flags, experiment analytics, multi-domain testing

calls.title: GrowthBook & Van De Velde Proposal
calls.summary: The discussion revolved around a revised proposal presented by James Shannon, which included a business case showcasing expected cost savings and operational improvements aimed at facilitating internal discussions led by Janne Vdv. The implementation timeline was confirmed for September due to ongoing technical rework, which required flexibility in contract start and invoicing. The meeting also compared the current A/B testing methods with Growthbook's capabilities, identifying potential benefits such as reduced reliance on external agencies. However, estimated cost savings were challenged by Janne, who highlighted ongoing agency costs and the importance of simpler solutions aligned with their budget. Ultimately, the conversation ended with an openness to revisit the proposal in August if client needs evolved.
calls.keywords: A/B testing, GrowthBook, feature flags, BigQuery, CRO agency, implementation timeline
